description: Machine-readable environment contract for FranKenstein 3.0. Precedence and field names are verified against plugins/frankenstein3/scripts/star/f3_paths.py and plugins/frankenstein3/README.md. Every entry of sources is a repo-root-relative path written in the canonical ../../<repo-root-relative> form and resolved from this file's directory (docs/zero). Tests fail closed: a missing or unreadable contract is an error, never a skip.

resolution_rules.F3_DB_PATH: file path to the database file; it never selects the data directory
resolution_rules.XDG_DATA_HOME: XDG base directory; frankenstein3 subdirectory appended

invariants: F3_DRY_RUN never participates in path precedence
Exactly one data directory is selected (first match wins)
Missing or unreadable contract is a hard error
F3_DB_PATH resolves the database file only and never selects the data directory
